title: Speculator AST Schema
description: AST-first schema for Speculator workspace. A workspace contains one or more specification documents. Semantic marker nodes are introduced during parse and may be refined during resolve. Global indexing aggregates definitions across documents.

SourcePos.description: Source position for bidirectional AST-to-source mapping

children.description: Optional rich inline code semantics in source order.

allOf.description: Inline definition marker (dfn). The term and children are parse-level requirements. The canonical id may be author-specified or assigned/refined during resolve. Indexed during the indexing phase.

id.description: Canonical unique identifier for this definition. May be assigned/refined during resolve.

linkTexts.description: Alternative link texts from data-lt attribute. Parse fills from data-lt or [term].

forContexts.description: For-contexts from data-dfn-for attribute (e.g., owning interface). Parse fills from data-dfn-for or [null].

dfnType.description: Definition type from data-dfn-type (e.g., dfn, attribute, method). Defaults to 'dfn'.

allOf.description: Reference to a section by its ID. Resolved during post-processing to obtain section numbers/titles.

targetId.description: The ID of the target section.

targetNumber.description: Resolved section number (e.g., '1.2.3'). Filled during compute phase.

targetTitle.description: Resolved section title. Filled during compute phase.

children.description: Optional custom link text. If omitted, the renderer should use the section number (e.g., 'Section 1.2').

allOf.description: RFC 2119 requirement keyword. Indexed during the indexing phase.
Open issue or TODO marker. Indexed during the indexing phase.
Citation marker. The key is parse-level; resolve may link to a bibliography entry and validate presence/ambiguity. Indexed during the indexing phase.

kind.description: Final citation kind. Determined by forcing or section context.

expanded.description: True for [[[FOO]]] form - displays full title.

forcedNormative.description: True if [[!FOO]] or data-cite starts with !.

targetId.description: Resolved ID of the bibliography entry. Filled during resolve phase.

url.description: Resolved URL of the citation. Filled during resolve phase.

children.description: Optional inline content that represents the cite text.

allOf.description: Algorithm variable marker (e.g., |x| in ReSpec). Rendered as <var> in HTML.
Generic inline HTML element preserved in AST for renderer-level passthrough.

dataCopConcept.description: Optional Class of Products (COP) identifier for this paragraph scope.

noToc.description: If true, the section created from this heading will not be numbered and will be omitted from the TOC.

noTocCount.description: If true, this heading and its children will not increment the section counter and will not be numbered, but will still be included in the TOC.

dataCopConcept.description: Optional Class of Products (COP) identifier for this heading/section scope.

children.description: Always empty - code blocks are leaf nodes with raw value content

allOf.description: Example block. Indexed during the indexing phase.

children.description: Always empty - thematic breaks are void/leaf nodes
Always empty - LikeC4 views are leaf nodes
Always empty - HTML blocks are leaf nodes with raw value content

allOf.description: Generic HTML element preserved as a structural block for renderer-level passthrough.
Note or aside block. Content is informative (non-normative). Used for <aside>, <div class='note'>, etc.

noteType.description: Type of note, derived from class or element semantics.

informative.description: Always true - marks content scope as informative for citation classification.

src.description: Optional source URL, e.g., for issue notes.

data.description: Optional payload data fetched from the source.

allOf.description: A semantic statement node (normative or informative). Auto-detects RFC 2119 keywords and handles JSON-LD harvesting.

id.description: Unique identifier for this statement. If not explicitly provided, it is finalized from tempId during post-processing.

tempId.description: Temporary/candidate identifier used during parse before uniqueness is guaranteed.

level.description: The requirement level of the statement.

contentText.description: Plain text content of the statement (collapsed whitespace).

dataCopConcept.description: Optional explicit Class of Products (COP) identifier for this statement.

dataIdPattern.description: Optional pattern (e.g. `req-{\d}`, `req-{\a}`) to assign deterministic IDs to generated nested statements.

allOf.description: A structural container for a group of spec statements (e.g. derived from a list). Does not carry a normative level itself.

id.description: Optional unique identifier for the group container.

dataCopConcept.description: Optional explicit Class of Products (COP) identifier for this group scope.

dataIdPattern.description: Optional pattern (e.g. `req-{\d}`, `req-{\a}`) to assign deterministic IDs to generated nested statements.

allOf.description: A section groups related content. Supports in-place authoring without includes.

noToc.description: If true, this section and its descendants do not increment the TOC counter at this level and are omitted from the TOC.

noTocCount.description: If true, this section and its descendants do not increment the section counter and are not numbered, but are still included in the TOC.

dataCopConcept.description: Optional Class of Products (COP) identifier for this section scope.

number.description: Optional hierarchical section number from source (for lossless import).

boilerplate.description: Optional marker when section originates from Bikeshed boilerplate slots.

omitted.description: Optional marker for boilerplate sections explicitly omitted by source metadata.

IndexDefinitionEntry.description: Entry in the definitions index, extracted from InlineDefinition nodes

documentId.description: ID of the document containing this definition

IndexReferenceEntry.description: Entry in the references index, extracted from InlineReference nodes

IndexRequirementEntry.description: Entry in the requirements index, extracted from InlineRequirement nodes

IndexIssueEntry.description: Entry in the issues index, extracted from InlineIssue nodes

IndexExampleEntry.description: Entry in the examples index, extracted from BlockExample nodes

IndexCiteEntry.description: Entry in the citations index, extracted from InlineCite nodes

IndexBiblioEntry.description: Entry in the bibliography index, merged from config and/or authored biblio sources during resolve/index phases

status.description: Optional status or classification for the reference (e.g., 'standard', 'draft')

IndexStatementEntry.description: Entry in the statements index, extracted from BlockSpecStatement nodes

subject.description: Resolved requirement subject IRI (Class of Product)

DocumentIndexes.description: Indexes extracted from AST marker nodes during indexing within a single document.

GlobalIndex.description: Aggregated global index across all documents in a workspace.

ComputedFields.description: Optional computed fields. Marked x-computed for semantic/full AST distinction.

toc.description: Table of contents derived from headings

headingNumbers.description: Map of heading ID to hierarchical number string

headingTitles.description: Map of heading ID to plain text title

statementsJsonLd.description: Embedded machine-readable statements/requirements in JSON-LD format.

InlineReference.description: Union of all inline reference types

DocumentMetadata.description: Document-level metadata from frontmatter or config

id.description: Document identifier, used as slug for internal link resolution. Synced from config.id

indexes.description: Indexes extracted from marker nodes during indexing

ReferenceSource.description: Optional source fidelity metadata from the original Bikeshed anchor/link.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for this AST format

documents.description: Collection of documents in the workspace

globalIndex.description: Aggregated global index across all documents
